title: Be alert: targeted attacks on prominent Rustaceans
summary: <p><strong><a href="https://blog.rust-lang.org/2026/09/17/targeted-attacks/">Be alert: targeted attacks on prominent Rustaceans</a></strong></p> Important warning from Adam Harvey and the crates security team:</p> <blockquote> <p>We believe that there is an ongoing campaign targeting rust-lang members and owners of popular crates that is attempting to compromise devices and accounts in order to use them to publish malware.</p> <p>
